title: Salt Peachy Nicotine Salt E-Liquid
description: Peachy is an irresistible blend of soft, sweet peaches with tart, sunny apricots and finished with a delicate layer of cream for an unbelievably moreish vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
